verdict.rationale: Asking a cloud platform for built-in AI insights on its own data (sessions, metrics, usage) is a fair question, so the axis applies. However, no evidence shows LiveKit generating AI insights or suggestions from a user's data inside the product. The evidence covers building blocks for developers to construct agents (knowledge-base chatbots, Agent Builder, Inference), non-AI metrics dashboards, and a docs MCP for coding agents. None of these is in-product AI analysis of user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
